title: Official KPGU Admission Process Steps
content:
Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara - Official Step-by-Step Admission Process:
Step 1: Online Registration & Application Form Submission on the official KPGU portal (www.kpgu.ac.in) or ACPC Gujarat portal for engineering/pharmacy courses.
Step 2: Document Submission & Verification of 10th/12th marksheets, entrance exam scorecards (KSET / GUJCET / NEET / ACPC), and photo ID.
Step 3: Merit List Declaration & Seat Allocation based on academic performance, ACPC merit rank, or KSET score.
Step 4: Issuance of Provisional Admission Offer Letter by the KPGU Admissions Cell.
Step 5: Fee Payment & Token Fee Submission to confirm the allocated seat within the stipulated deadline.
Step 6: Final Enrollment, Original Document Verification, and Campus Orientation.
